description: Somos un equipo de 2do de Primaria del North Schools de Punta del Este
summary: Our game simulates what life could be like in space. It helps future astronauts prepare for real space missions. Our game presents obstacles to train astronauts.
details: Our game simulates a space trip. To play, users need to move using the arrow keys to navigate a maze. These movements will help them to have a better performance in space.
